messages.content: You are a senior engineer working in an existing repository. Return the complete corrected or requested source file in a single fenced code block. Do not add commentary outside the block. Do not invent APIs that are not shown to you.

Write a Unity MonoBehaviour `ProjectilePool` in C# that pools GameObjects. Requirements:
  - a [SerializeField] GameObject prefab and int prewarmCount
  - Awake() prewarms `prewarmCount` inactive instances
  - public GameObject Rent() returns a pooled instance, activating it, and instantiates a new one only when the pool is empty
  - public void Return(GameObject go) deactivates it and puts it back
  - Return(null) is ignored; returning the same object twice must not add it twice
Use only UnityEngine and System.Collections.Generic. Return the whole file.
